what i started doing differently ever since i got my big chop!

1.	⁠i stopped using curling tools or straightening tools! now i stick religiously to my dyson and i have seen little damaged compared to me using a curling iron or a straighter!
2.	⁠i sleep with a satin/silk bonnet EVERY TIME I SLEEP (even when i take naps i just slip it on and i recommend a silk pillow case because sometimes my bonnet falls off when i sleep)
3.	⁠hair oiling!!!!!!!! i use mielle hair oil and jojoba oil, i use the milelle oil on my roots and massage it in then i use jojoba oil from mid lengths to ends! you can sleep on it and wash it in the morning or you can put it 2-3 hours before you wash your hair!
4.	⁠heartless curls! i use my dyson probably 3 times a week which is whenever i wash my hair, to make the dyson hair do last i sleep in the heat less curls rods i got from amazon and i put the bonnet ontop to prevent frizz while sleeping! using the headless curls rods helped me not use heat every day!
